build_aot_forward_graph: build a forward-only compiled FX graph from a flat function, tensor arguments, AOT config, and view/mutation metadata
build_aot_autograd_graph: build a joint forward-backward compiled FX graph with traced tangents for autograd via AOT config and mutation metadata
create_fx_graph_module: create an FX GraphModule by tracing a callable with make_fx under FunctionalTensorMode and a decomposition table
dispatch_forward_only_graph: dispatch a function to the forward-only compilation pathway handling input mutations and subclass desugaring
dispatch_joint_autograd_graph: dispatch a function to the joint forward-backward compilation pathway with autograd support and subclass handling
